title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya trailer launch: Sooraj Barjatya's BIG advice to young filmmakers: “DON’T worry about Day 1 collections…log Diwali ka bonus aake spend karenge. So, your film better be entertaining!”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

He shared, “I feel so grateful that I have been making films for 40 years. Yet people come to see this cinema!” From the audience section, Anupam Kher shouted, “That's because you are Sooraj Barjatya!”

Adding to this, Sooraj Barjatya smiled and continued, “So, thank you so much for coming here, for giving so much love to the music of this movie, and for liking the simplicity of this family movie so much.”

Meanwhile, He then introduced the senior-most members of his family, who are also the producers of Yeh Prem Mol Liya . Sooraj Barjatya pointed at them and shared, “Today, I'd like to take this opportunity to tell everyone that these are our backbones. These people not only put the money in people like me but they also teach us the importance of stories. These are the people who back the story and not the look of a movie!”

Notably, He added, “To all the young filmmakers, I want to share some wisdom that I have learnt over the years. Firstly, they (the producers) have taught us to make your movie and not worry about the first day, second day, third day collections. Because it is the movie which works. Har picture ki apni kundli hoti hain. Koi gaadi fast nikalti hain, koi gaadi slow nikalti hain par sab gaadi niklegi .”

As per the latest buzz, He continued, “Secondly, they have taught us to make an entertaining movie. I have heard this a lot that log Diwali ka bonus aake spend karenge . So, your movie better be entertaining! And thirdly, I want to tell all the young makers that they have taught me to have confidence in this profession. Kyunki ek movie nahin chalegi, toh dusri chalegi . There's no other profession where you get a faster chance because it is the story which works or breaks. It is not the maker.”

In further updates, At another point in the event, Sooraj Barjatya revealed, “When I was a younger filmmaker, I used to always think that meri movie no 1 bane ya no 2 bane ya no 3 bane . But at 61, I don't have that bandhan or bandish anymore. I am much freer today. I'd like my movie to resonate well.”

On top of that, He also thanked those who have religiously watched all his films, “I have seen the same people come again and again for 40 years. Now they come with their dadi, nani, etc. I have seen them grow up with me.”
Yeh Prem Mol Liya releases in cinemas on November 27.

title: Sonu Nigam leases out three Mumbai commercial properties for Rs. 12 lakhs per month after purchasing them for Rs. 17 crores

Adding to this, At the heart of the trailer is a relationship that moves from dating to marriage, but not quite along the lines audiences might expect from a traditional family drama. Here, the husband moves into his wife's home, challenging the usual expectation of a bride adjusting to life in her marital home. The movie also firmly places its female protagonist in the driver’s seat, presenting a woman with agency and say in how she wants her relationship and family life to pan out. The idea is beyond the familiar dichotomy of sasural and mayka, that a marriage can create space for both partners and their families.

Meanwhile, The trailer also gives Ayushmann and Sharvari ample room to play off each other. Their chemistry brings the romance to the fore, with the line, “Agar itna bhi nahin kiya toh kya pyaar kiya?”, capturing the movie’s spirited take on what it means to go the distance for love. Rather than simply revisiting the familiar tropes of a Rajshri romance, Barjatya seems to be looking at how relationships and family equations are evolving.

title: Ramayana box office collection day 14: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash's film surpasses Dhurandhar's lifetime haul, crosses ₹840 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Nitesh Tiwari 's Ramayana has achieved another major box-office milestone, surpassing the lifetime India net collection of Dhurandhar as it crossed ₹ 840 crore rupees. The movie continues to draw audiences to theatres, even though the Ranbir Kapoor , Sai Pallavi and Yash-starrer saw a dip in its daily collection in second week.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor wearing Assam's handmade cane-rubber armour in Ramayana. Ramayana ticket-window earnings On Day 14, Ramayana collected ₹ 23.20 crore rupees net, according to Sacnilk. With its latest earnings, Ramayana has reached a total net collection in India of ₹ 844.40 crore rupees. The movie's day 14 collection came from 21,215 shows across the country. Interestingly, Dhurandhar The Revenge collected ₹ 20.10 crore rupees on its fourteenth day whilst it was running in theatres from March 19 onwards. The Ranveer Singh-starrer collected ₹ 919.52 crore rupees net in India in the first two weeks.

Meanwhile, Earlier this month, producer Namit Malhotra spoke to news agency PTI about what he hopes to achieve with the movie. "In India, there are a lot of questions like, 'Why are they making the Ramayana when there have been so many Ramayanas? We already know the story.' And I'm like, 'Listen, we're making it because we want to show you the version of this story that you've never seen.' No television show, no street play, no Ram Leela has ever shown you the Ramayana on this scale and with this spectacle that we are making...Much like an Avatar or an Avengers movie or think about Spider-Man or The Odyssey. We're putting Ramayana right up there next to all of those spectacles," Namit shared.

Notably, Talking about the movie's global ambitions, Namit added, “If you think about the West, they are the most potent audience for anything that's got a grand epic spectacle. And that's just not how Indian films have been made. So while India makes terrific Indian movies, whether it is 'Baahubali', 'Dhurandhar', or any of the big, super-duper hit films, they are not spectacles the way Hollywood thinks of spectacles. We are first trying to narrow that gap down and saying, 'If you can do it, we can do it too.' There's no reason for us to have any discrepancy. So, every person in Hollywood should acknowledge that India can also do something as good, if not bigger, than what they do.”

As per the latest buzz, Starring Ranbir Kapoor , Yash and Sai Pallavi, Ramayana has seen strong audience interest since its rollout. The two-part adaptation follows Prince Rama (Ranbir Kapoor) and Sita (Sai Pallavi) during their exile, before Ravana's (Yash) abduction of Sita leads to the battle between good and evil. The movie is produced by Namit Malhotra's Prime Focus Studios and Yash's Monster Mind Creations. Made for a global audience and filmed for IMAX, Part 1 arrived during the Diwali holiday period, while Part 2 is scheduled to rollout during Diwali 2027.

title: Lara Dutta and Mahesh Bhupathi's daughter Saira wins tennis championship in UAE, actor shares proud moment
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Lara Dutta is currently enjoying the success of her latest rollout, Ramayana . However, she has another reason to celebrate. The star of late posted on Instagram to share pictures from a tennis tournament featuring her daughter, Saira, who won a championship at the Tennis & Country Club in Fujairah, UAE.

Adding to this, Lara Dutta celebrated her daughter Saira’s tennis championship win. Lara Dutta celebrates daughter's win Lara shared a series of pictures from the tournament, including one in which she posed with her daughter for a mirror selfie in a lift. Other pictures showed Saira on the tennis court and posing with her trophy and prize cheque alongside two officials after her win. Lara, however, made sure to conceal her daughter's face with emojis in all the pictures.

Meanwhile, Sharing the pictures, Lara penned a heartfelt note celebrating her daughter's achievement and how much she has grown. She wrote, “Went on tour with my ( taller than me now) baby girl……… and came back with the WIN! So proud.”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Lara Dutta Bhupathi (@larabhupathi)

As per the latest buzz, Lara Dutta married former tennis player Mahesh Bhupathi in February 2011. The couple first had a civil wedding in Mumbai, followed by a traditional Christian wedding ceremony in Goa. They welcomed their daughter, Saira, in January 2012.

In further updates, Mahesh is one of India's most successful tennis players, with 12 Grand Slam titles across men's doubles and mixed doubles. He was also the first Indian to win a Grand Slam title in men's doubles.

On top of that, Lara Dutta plays Queen Kaikeyi in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana. In a recent interaction with SCREEN, Lara defended her character, who sends Lord Rama into exile. She shared, “She was caught between her love as a mother and her duty as a mother to enforce what was her son’s birthright. If she didn’t fight for her son, in a massive kingdom like Ayodhya, where there was so much intrigue and court politics at play, he’d lose what was promised to him at birth. It’s an incredibly complex character to play. She’s always been portrayed as a villain, but if you actually look at it, it’s shared in a different version that she took birth with the divine purpose to make Lord Rama fulfil the prophecy of vanquishing Ravana and restoring peace and faith on Earth.”

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the Hindu epic. The first installment, which rolled out in theatres worldwide on November 5, stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana.

title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya trailer: Ayushmann Khurrana, Sharvari's love story challenges age-old marriage tradition of brides leaving their homes
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

What if a husband moved into his wife's home after marriage instead of the other way around? Sooraj Barjatya explores this question in his soon-to-release movie Yeh Prem Mol Liya. The trailer, unveiled on Wednesday, features Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari as a couple trying to find their way through love, family expectations and a marriage custom that has rarely been questioned. Barjatya, known for his family dramas and romantic stories, takes a familiar subject and turns the roles around.

Adding to this, Yeh Prem Mol Liya trailer: Ayushmann Khurrana becomes the ghar jamai for Sharvari in Sooraj Barjatya's movie. Trailer breakdown of Yeh Prem Mol Liya Ayushmann Khurrana is the new Prem in Sooraj Barjatya's movie universe. He plays a young man in love with Sharvari's Purva and eager to marry her. Purva, however, has one condition that makes things complicated. She comes from a family of women and does not want to leave them behind after marriage. She feels responsible for looking after her loved ones and is not comfortable with the idea of moving into her husband's home. Understanding her dilemma, Prem offers to do the opposite. He tells her he is ready to move into her house and live with her family after the wedding. The proposal comes as a shock to his own family.

Meanwhile, At the heart of the trailer is a question that challenges a long-standing marriage tradition: why should a woman always be the one expected to leave her home? Prem's decision to move in with Purva turns that expectation around. But while he sees it as a way to be with the woman he loves, his family is not quite ready to accept it. This sets up the conflict between the two families, with Prem and Purva caught between their feelings and what is expected of them.

Notably, The story may remind viewers of Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani, which explored two people stepping into each other's family lives and understanding their different ways of living. Yeh Prem Mol Liya, however, takes on the specific expectation that a bride must leave her parental home after marriage. The trailer ends with Prem saying, “Itna bhi nahi kiya, toh kya pyaar kiya”, making his stand clear. For him, being with Purva matters more than following a tradition simply because it has always been done that way.

As per the latest buzz, The movie marks Sooraj's first directorial outing after Uunchai, which won a National Movie Award. It also brings back Prem, a character closely associated with Rajshri Productions and its popular romantic dramas. More than a decade after the character's last big-screen appearance, which has been played by Salman Khan and Shahid Kapoor previously, Ayushmann takes on the role for the first time.

In further updates, Yeh Prem Mol Liya is produced by Rajshri Productions (P) Ltd. with Mahaveer Jain Films. Himesh Reshammiya has composed the music, reuniting with Barjatya after Prem Ratan Dhan Payo. The song Jhumka Patola has already crossed one million views. The movie is set to rollout in theatres on November 27, 2026.

title: SCOOP: Sanjay Leela Bhansali makes a BIG move! Bhansali Productions to venture into film distribution and acquisition
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama , “Bhansali Productions is ready to go to the next level and has decided to enter movie distribution in 2027. They are looking at significant films made outside their banner that they can distribute. They have even brought Ashish Pandey on board, who'll spearhead the distribution arm.”

Adding to this, Ashish Pandey is a senior industry professional with more than two decades of experience in the entertainment business. As per his LinkedIn profile, he began his career as Regional Distribution Manager at Reliance Entertainment in November 2005. He then spent around 10 years working in various capacities in the distribution division of 20th Century Studios, followed by stints in theatrical distribution at Star TV Network and Walt Disney. He subsequently joined Cineline India Ltd, which operates the popular MovieMax cinema chain. During his 2 ½ year stint with the company, he headed programming. Finally, in March 2026, Ashish Pandey joined Bhansali Productions as Head – Revenue, Monetisation & Global Sales.

Meanwhile, Interestingly, despite Bhansali Productions' plans to enter distribution, its much-awaited movie Love & War will not be distributed by the company. Explaining the reason, the trade source shared, “Pen Marudhar has been committed to releasing Love & War globally for a long time. It was a commitment made much before Bhansali Productions decided to venture into distribution. But going forward, Bhansali Productions is expected to distribute films made under its own banner and also look out for films made outside the production house.”
Notably, Bhansali Productions is now the second production house in recent times, after Dharma Productions, to venture into movie distribution following a successful stint in movie production.

title: Sidharth Malhotra and Kiara Advani request privacy after daughter Saraayah’s face appears in airport video
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The appeal comes after a clip of the family at an airport surfaced online and quickly spread across social media. The actors have kept their one-year-old daughter away from public attention and have now urged people to respect their privacy by avoiding the footage or blurring her face before sharing it.

Adding to this, Sidharth Malhotra and Kiara Advani have requested media outlets and social media pages to respect their daughter's privacy after a video of the one-year-old surfaced online. title: SC issues notice to CJP, Congress, AAP, AISA on traders’ plea against Delhi protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Supreme Court on Wednesday sought responses from political parties, including the Congress and the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), and organisations such as the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and the All India Students Union (AISA), on a petition by market traders’ associations challenging the designation of Ramlila Maidan as a protest venue. The traders have argued that demonstrations at the ground disrupt business, affect livelihoods and deny access to roads leading to nearby residential areas.

Adding to this, The bench, also comprising justices Joymalya and V Mohana, sought responses from the Centre, the Delhi government, the Congress, the AAP, the CJP and AISA. It agreed to take up the matter after two weeks. (File Photo) A bench headed by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant issued notices on a petition filed by the Kirana Committee of Delhi and the Delhi Iron and Hardware Merchants Association of Chawri Bazar on October 16, ahead of a proposed “Lehra Do Tiranga” march organised by the CJP at Connaught Place, with participation by AISA, on the same day.

Meanwhile, The bench, also comprising justices Joymalya and V Mohana, sought responses from the Centre, the Delhi government, the Congress, the AAP, the CJP and AISA. It agreed to take up the matter after two weeks.

Notably, Senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi, appearing for the petitioners, shared, “I am also challenging the notification of Ramlila Maidan as a protest site is also wrong. This location is within close proximity of prominent markets such as Connaught Place, Chandni Chowk, Chawri Bazar, Khari Baoli and Sadar Bazar.”

As per the latest buzz, Solicitor general Tushar Mehta, appearing for the Centre, told the top court that the matter has to be taken up with the petitions challenging the police action during the Delhi protests. Mehta shared, “This court is hearing the other set of petitions seeking their right to protest. And this matter is protesting that right citing the fundamental rights of traders, workers, and residents. These are contesting rights and should be heard together.”

In further updates, In their petition, the traders shared Ramlila Maidan was “surrounded by dense residential localities and wholesale and retail markets of Old Delhi, where thousands of workers, traders and vendors operate”. They argued that the designation was made without a published assessment of its impact on residents and businesses, or safeguards concerning the number of demonstrators, duration of protests, damage to property and liability.

On top of that, On November 3, while hearing the petition, the court had asked whether the organisations that had called for protests had been made parties to the case. Following the suggestion, the petitioners added the Congress , which organised a rally at Ramlila Maidan on November 1, along with the AAP, the CJP and AISA.
The bench had observed that protests affected the livelihood of people working in shops and those earning their living by selling goods on carts and stalls.

title: Saif Ali Khan tells Prince William ‘India has moved beyond the royal system’ while discussing his royal lineage
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Saif Ali Khan opened up about his meeting with Prince William at Dharma Productions, revealing that they spoke about strengthening cultural ties between India and the UK. Their conversation touched upon the movie industries of both countries, cinema, music and cricket. In conversation with the media after the interaction, the star shared they also discussed opportunities for greater collaboration between the two countries.

Adding to this, Bollywood movie director and producer Karan Johar (2L), Bollywood actors Saif Ali Khan (2R) and Kareena Kapoor Khan (R), Britain's Prince William, Prince of Wales (L) applaud as they meet at the office of Dharma Productions in Mumbai on November 18, 2026. (Photo by Punit PARANJPE / AFP) (AFP) What did Saif Ali Khan say? "This session was about cultural cooperation and the movie industries of the United Kingdom (UK) and India working together," Saif shared. Describing the meeting with Prince William, Saif shared it was a light-hearted conversation involving films, songs and cricket. "It was a light conversation about films, songs, and a little bit about cricket," he shared.

Meanwhile, He also opened up that they spoke about his late father, former Indian cricket captain Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi, popularly known as Tiger Pataudi, and his experiences playing cricket in England and India. When asked whether his royal background came up during the interaction, Saif shared, "They did mention it, but I was quick to point out that in India we do not have a royal system anymore."

Notably, Saif also lauded Prince William's work as an ambassador for environmental causes, including climate action and green energy, calling the Earthshot Prize a "fantastic thing". Highlighting the UK's long-standing association with Bollywood, the star shared, "The UK has been a favourite destination for Bollywood for a very long time."

As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram Referring to recent developments, the star mentioned Yash Raj Films' agreement to make films in the UK and stressed the need to explore further opportunities for collaboration. "We used to make a lot of films there, and I think in the future also we'll have to see how we work together. I think a lot of people, of late Yash Raj has also signed something and made an agreement to make some films, " shared Saif.

In further updates, Reflecting on how Bollywood's storytelling has evolved, Saif noted that earlier films were often more NRI-friendly, while contemporary cinema increasingly looks inward at India's own culture and stories. "Earlier, the movies we used to make were sort of more NRI-friendly. But now, since so much of our culture is looking inside at our own country, we'll have to find a way in the future to see how UK stories fit into that narrative. It'll be very interesting to find out," he added.

On top of that, Prince William's visit to Dharma Productions saw him receive a Bollywood-style welcome from filmmaker Karan Johar, along with actors Kareena Kapoor Khan and Saif Ali Khan. The interaction also featured a dance performance on 'Shava Shava', the popular track from Karan's movie Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham.

Earlier in the day, Prince William and Princess Catherine visited the Chanakya School of Craft in Mumbai's Lower Parel. The engagement focused on sustainable textiles and was part of their India visit for the Earthshot Prize 2026. The royal couple had attended the Earthshot Prize ceremony on November 17, which saw global environmental innovators come together with several well-known faces from entertainment, sports and music.

title: Karan Johar, Kareena Kapoor get nostalgic as they revisit Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham shoot memories with Prince William
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Prince William's visit to Karan Johar 's Dharma Productions office turned into a nostalgic affair for the filmmaker and Kareena Kapoor on Wednesday. Accompanied by Saif Ali Khan, the two welcomed the Prince of Wales and spent the afternoon discussing cinema, stories and cultural connections. Karan later opened up that their conversation also took them back to the making of Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham.

Adding to this, Kareena Kapoor, Saif Ali Khan and Karan Johar with Prince William. Karan Johar shares glimpse from meeting with Prince William On Wednesday, Karan posted on Instagram to share pictures from his meeting with Prince William and revealed what they discussed. He wrote, "It was truly an honour and a delight to welcome His Royal Highness The Prince of Wales, Prince William, to @dharmamovies. What followed was an afternoon of wonderful conversations around the magic of cinema, the stories that shape us and the connections that transcend cultures."
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Karan Johar (@karanjohar)

Notably, He further revealed how he and Kareena got nostalgic, writing, "A particularly warm moment was of revisiting memories from the making of Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham, sharing anecdotes from those much-loved shooting days! @kareenakapoorkhan and I felt rather nostalgic! There is something incredibly beautiful about how cinema brings the world closer. Moments like these are a reminder that beyond borders, languages and cultures, stories have an extraordinary ability to connect us. And in doing so, they continue to strengthen the enduring bond between India and the UK. Because stories, truly, know no borders. Thank you to His Royal Highness for spending such invaluable time with us! @princeandprincessofwales."

As per the latest buzz, Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham (K3G), one of Bollywood's most loved family dramas, is set to complete 25 years in December this year. Directed by Karan Johar, the movie was rolled out on December 14, 2001, and went on to become a landmark in Hindi cinema. Starring Amitabh Bachchan, Jaya Bachchan, Shah Rukh Khan, Kajol, Hrithik Roshan and Kareena Kapoor Khan, the movie revolved around the Raichand family. Its iconic dialogues, memorable characters, grand sets, costumes and soundtrack continue to hold a special place in popular culture.

In further updates, Beyond its box-office success, K3G became a pop-culture phenomenon. Characters such as Poo and Anjali, and songs such as Bole Chudiyan, Suraj Hua Maddham and You Are My Soniya, remain popular even years later. Kareena's character Poo has also found a whole new fan base among Gen Z audiences.

On top of that, The Karan Johar directorial was shot across several international locations, including the UK. A significant portion of the movie was shot in London and other parts of the UK, with locations such as Waddesdon Manor in Buckinghamshire, Blenheim Palace in Oxfordshire and Canary Wharf featuring in the movie. The movie emerged as a smash hit.

title: Dhanush, Juhi Chawla, Varun Dhawan react to MS Dhoni's IPL retirement, say ‘game will never be quite the same’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After playing in the Indian Premier League (IPL) for 18 seasons, Mahendra Singh Dhoni has brought the curtains down on his playing career. His IPL retirement also marked the cricketer's final tryst with professional cricket in a career that lasted over two decades. The announcement was followed by emotional reactions from Chennai Super Kings followers and celebrities. Actors Juhi Chawla , Varun Dhawan and Dhanush also took to social media to share heartfelt messages for the cricket legend.

Adding to this, Dhanush and Juhi Chawla shared emotional messages after MS Dhoni revealed his retirement from his IPL playing career. Juhi Chawla recalls how Dhoni turned Kolkata's Eden Gardens yellow Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) co-owner and star Juhi Chawla took to social media to share a nostalgic message for Dhoni. She recalled a match between KKR and CSK at Kolkata's Eden Gardens and how, despite KKR playing on their home ground, the stadium turned yellow as spectators turned up wearing CSK jerseys to support Dhoni. Thousands of followers also chanted his name.

Meanwhile, Recalling the match, she wrote, "Mahi, I'll always remember KKR-CSK nights at Eden Gardens. It is usually purple. But when Chennai plays, the stadium turns yellow, because of you. And when you walk out, 60,000 people chant “Dhoni, Dhoni”. That's the impact you have! Wishing you the very best for your next chapter!! #MSDhoni #IPL2027."

Notably, Dhanush shared an emotional note on X (formerly Twitter), saying that the game would not be the same without MS Dhoni. He wrote, "Some players entertain us. Some become a part of our lives. MS Dhoni has been both. Thank you for all the memories. The game will never be quite the same without you, but I'll wait to see you on the sidelines. Thousands of youngsters have benefited from your advice and knowledge, hope it continues to inspire and fire up the soon-to-release generation. Farewell champion."

As per the latest buzz, Star Karthi also penned a heartfelt note for the former CSK captain. Calling himself fortunate to have witnessed Dhoni's journey, he wrote, "Fortunate to belong to a generation that witnessed a young man grow into a legend right before our eyes! #Dhoni Saab, Number 7 will forever be more than just a number. For Chennai, it stands for countless emotions, unforgettable victories and those magical moments that made millions of us believe that it’s never over until it’s over. You’ve inspired an entire generation, not just through your game, but through your humility, grace and the way you’ve carried yourself both on and off the field. Wherever the journey takes you, you’ll always be our Thala! Lots of love and best wishes."

In further updates, Meanwhile, Varun Dhawan reshared Dhoni's emotional social media post following the retirement announcement. Sharing it on his Instagram Stories, the star wrote, "Captain India." Arjun Kapoor also reacted to the announcement, writing, "End of an era."

On top of that, CSK revealed on November 17 that the former India captain has ended his IPL playing career but will take up the role of Team Mentor from the 2027 season. Dhoni joined Chennai Super Kings in the inaugural IPL season in 2008. He led CSK to five IPL titles, making it one of the most successful franchises in the league. He also guided the team to two Champions League T20 titles.

title: Bharatbala reunites with AR Rahman for Banaras, film to premiere at IFFI 2026
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

National Award-winning filmmaker Bharatbala is set to return to feature filmmaking with Banaras, bringing him together once again with celebrated composer AR Rahman , who also serves as the movie's Executive Producer.

Adding to this, Bharatbala returns to direction with Banaras. Bharatbala returns to direction Starring Abhishek Banerjee, Shahana Goswami, Neeraj Kabi, Chhaya Kadam, Indira Tiwari and Antonythasan Jesuthasan, among others, the movie has been officially selected for the Indian Panorama section of the International Movie Festival of India ( IFFI ) 2026, where it will have its India Premiere.

Meanwhile, Set against the rich cultural and musical landscape of Indian classical music, Banaras is an intimate father-daughter story that explores relationships, emotions and the enduring bonds between generations.

Notably, The movie brings together an ensemble cast featuring actors known for their acclaimed performances. Abhishek Banerjee, following his work in Stolen, joins Shahana Goswami, who collected international recognition for her performance in Santosh. The cast also includes Neeraj Kabi, Chhaya Kadam and Indira Tiwari, alongside Antonythasan Jesuthasan, known for his performance in Jacques Audiard's acclaimed movie Dheepan, as per the press rollout.

As per the latest buzz, Speaking about the movie's selection for IFFI, director Bharatbala shared in a note, "Banaras has been a very special creative journey, bringing together a moving father-daughter story, an extraordinary ensemble cast featuring Shahana Goswami, Neeraj Kabi, Abhishek Banerjee and an exceptional creative team. Reuniting with A. R. Rahman has made this journey even more special. His music is integral to the soul of the movie. I am delighted that Banaras has been selected for the Indian Panorama at IFFI and look forward to sharing our movie with audiences."

In further updates, A National Award-winning filmmaker, Bharatbala has taken Indian stories to global audiences across formats, creating cinematic and cultural experiences celebrating India's heritage, identity and artistic expression. He received the National Movie Award for Ram Nami. Banaras marks his return to feature-movie direction after Maryan, the acclaimed 2013 movie starring Dhanush.

On top of that, The movie also marks another creative collaboration between Bharatbala and AR Rahman, following their work on Vande Mataram and Jana Gana Mana, among others. title: Ramayana's Kaikeyi, Lara Dutta, says Ranbir Kapoor and Yash-starrer will ‘far surpass’ its ₹4000 crore budget
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Bollywood star Lara Dutta is currently receiving praise for her performance as Kaikeyi in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana . The movie is enjoying a dream run at the ticket-window and has already crossed ₹ 1400 crore rupees worldwide in just 13 days. However, there has been considerable discussion about whether it will be able to recover its enormous reported budget of ₹ 4000 crore rupees (for both parts of the movie). Now, Lara has expressed confidence that the movie's collections will eventually surpass its budget.

Adding to this, Lara Dutta says Ramayana would cross ₹4000 crore rupees. Lara Dutta on Ramayana's ticket-window fate In a conversation with NDTV, Lara reacted to discussions about Ramayana's box-office prospects and shared the movie had finally put Indian cinema on the global stage, allowing it to stand tall alongside some of the finest films worldwide. She added that it took immense inner strength to ignore the naysayers and doubters, remain focused on their vision and continue pursuing it.

Meanwhile, She shared, “So, will the movie make its money back or recover it? I am pretty, pretty, pretty certain it will, not just through the ticket-window, but with whatever Namit has decided to do with it. I don't think it will just recover. I think it will far surpass it.”

Notably, She also lauded the makers for having the courage to invest such a huge amount in the project. She shared, “It takes a tremendous amount of bravery to literally put your money where your mouth is and to create something like this. Today, apart from being an star in this movie, I am so proud to be an Indian. When I saw that movie at the premiere, it made me so proud. And I think that's the one sentiment Indians across the world feel today. When they're going into a cinema and stepping out after watching this movie, they're all saying that.”

As per the latest buzz, Namit Malhotra had earlier verified that the budget of the mythological epic, which is set to rollout in two parts, is ₹ 4000 crore rupees. This makes Ramayana the most expensive movie ever made in Indian cinema. However, filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma of late claimed that the budget of Ramayana Part One is less than ₹ 800 crore rupees and that the first part would easily recover the movie's entire budget.

In further updates, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra under Prime Focus Studios, in association with Yash's Monster Mind Creations and DNEG, the movie is based on Valmiki's Ramayana. It features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. The first part is running in theatres while Part 2 will rollout in 2028. The movie opened to a largely positive response.

title: No Rockstar without Heer, no Drishyam without Tabu: Ananya Panday says Indian cinema always lets women shine
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Ananya Panday was one of the speakers at the 24th edition of the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit 2026, where she spoke about her career, Bollywood today and more. During her conversation with Sonal Kalra, Chief Managing Editor, Entertainment and Lifestyle, Hindustan Times, the star also opened up about how Hindi cinema had found a way to balance both men and women, and not just in stories where women were central figures.

Adding to this, Ananya Panday at the 24th Hindustan Times Leadership Summit, in conversation about cinema. (HT Photo) Ananya Panday on women finding balance in Indian cinema During the conversation, when asked if she had observed a change in attitudes towards female actors and the roles they got in big-budget productions, Ananya shared that the diverse nature of films in Indian cinema helped actors today. “I think the beauty of our movie industry is that we have all kinds of films. If we have testosterone-pumping films, we also have films like Lokah, Gangubai Kathiawadi, Kahaani, and Piku,” she shared.

Meanwhile, Ananya was on stage with filmmaker Imtiaz Ali, and she credited him for handling this balance beautifully in his films. “Imtiaz sir is an example of the balance he has struck between male and female emotions in his portrayal of characters. There would be no Rockstar without Heer. It's not like she exists in relation to him. He also exists in relation to her. He has created that so beautifully,” Ananya shared.

Notably, The star emphasised that this change is not limited to films where women are central, but also to supposedly ‘male-dominated’ films. Giving an example of the Drishyam franchise, led by Ajay Devgn, Ananya added, “We will always have examples of films where women shine, and it's not just about films where a woman is the central character. For instance, in Drishyam, a typically male-dominated movie, you cannot imagine it without Tabu or the other female characters. So, it is not about screen time but about what you bring to the movie.”

As per the latest buzz, During the conversation, Ananya also shared she was hopeful about how Indian films had stopped looking for the formula to success, and instead tried making things from the heart. “ A movie like Lokah, which is about an almost female superhero, is working, and then there is Imtiaz (Ali) sir's Main Waapas Aaunga, such a beautiful movie. It found its way into people's hearts. I am feeling very positive after a very long time, because now, as an industry, we are not following a recipe or relying on our old tricks, since we really don't know what's working. Hopefully, we can go back to making things from the heart rather than creating a formula,” shared the star.

In further updates, Abhimanyu Mathur is Deputy Editor, Entertainment at Hindustan Times. With almost 15 years of experience in writing about everything from films and TV shows to cricket matches and elections, he inhales and exhales pop culture and news. Currently, he watches movies and TV shows and talks to celebrities for a living, while occasionally writing about them as well. A journalism graduate of Delhi College of Arts and Commerce, Delhi University, Abhimanyu began his career with Hindustan Times at the age of 20, swapping classrooms for newsrooms at an early age. He began his journey in the early days of digital journalism, later switching to the madness of print journalism. Work has led him to far off places like Japan and Jordan, as well as to the interiors of Haryana and the Indo-Pak border. He dabbled in city reporting in places like Meerut, Gurgaon, and Delhi, covered the Olympics and Cricket World Cups, before finding his calling in entertainment and lifestyle during the pandemic. A Rotten Tomatoes Certified Movie Critic, he is equally at home covering stories on ground as he is interviewing celebrities and studios, and sometimes prefers to shepherd teams in delivering traffic through the day. Even as his role has evolved from reporter to supervisor over the years, his first love remains writing (and of late, talking on camera). With a good understanding of cinema and its trends, and a keen eye for detail, he continues to spark conversations around showbiz for readers around the world. Read More

title: SCOOP: Ramayana's BLOCKBUSTER run creates IMAX show-sharing hurdles for Godzilla Minus Zero; The Hunger Games may skip IMAX release
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama , “ Ramayana is a grand Indian IMAX rollout and is doing phenomenal business in IMAX theatres across the country. The movie had an exclusive two-week arrangement with IMAX. This is why Godzilla Minus Zero was pushed back by two weeks in India, although both films were rolled out in the same week, that is, November 5/6, in other markets. Now that Ramayana 's two-week exclusivity period is coming to an end, PVR INOX Pictures has decided to rollout Godzilla Minus Zero in IMAX. However, they have faced resistance from the distributors of Ramayana .”

Adding to this, The source continued, “PVR INOX understands that Ramayana is doing excellent business in IMAX. Hence, they have asked for just one show of Godzilla Minus Zero , that too in a prime time evening slot. However, Ramayana 's distributors have reservations about giving away even one show of their movie, especially during prime time. Their argument is that Ramayana continues to attract encouraging footfalls even for morning shows on weekdays in IMAX properties. Hence, it is obvious that the weekend footfalls will be even higher. In such a scenario, reducing one show, that too during peak evening hours, would not be beneficial for them.”

Meanwhile, The source further explained, “On the other hand, PVR INOX Pictures is trying to reason with them that the target audience of Godzilla Minus Zero largely comprises working professionals, who would prefer to watch the movie after office hours. This is why they are insisting on a show after 6:00 pm.”

Notably, The source added, “The issue is expected to be resolved today, following which advance bookings will open. It remains to be seen whether Godzilla Minus Zero manages to secure a prime time IMAX slot or whether it will have to settle for a morning or afternoon show.”

As per the latest buzz, Meanwhile, Bollywood Hungama has also learned that The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping might miss out on an IMAX rollout in India due to show-sharing issues. The Hollywood movie is also scheduled to arrive in Indian cinemas this Friday, November 20, and is the first movie in the franchise to receive the ‘Filmed for IMAX’ recognition. However, a trade source shared, “A clearer picture regarding the IMAX rollout of The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping will emerge by Wednesday evening.”

title: BREAKING: Yeh Prem Mol Liya is a RARE Sooraj Barjatya film to get U/A rating; is the third longest film of the blockbuster director
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

As per the website of the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC), the censor certificate was issued to the makers of Yeh Prem Mol Liya yesterday, November 17. Interestingly, the movie has been passed with a U/A 13+ certificate. This is a rare occurrence for a Sooraj Barjatya movie, as nearly all his previous directorial ventures have received a clean ‘U’ certificate. In fact, Yeh Prem Mol Liya is only the second movie of his directorial career to receive a U/A rating. The first was Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon (2003), starring Hrithik Roshan, Kareena Kapoor Khan and Abhishek Bachchan. His remaining films, namely Maine Pyar Kiya (1989), Hum Aapke Hain Koun (1994), Hum Saath Saath Hain (1999), Vivah (2006), Prem Ratan Dhan Payo (2015) and Uunchai (2022), were all passed with a ‘U’ certificate.

Adding to this, That's not all. The CBFC website also mentions that Yeh Prem Mol Liya is 173 minutes long, that is, 2 hours and 53 minutes. This makes it the third-longest movie of Sooraj Barjatya's career. His longest movie remains the all-time smash hit Hum Aapke Hain Koun , which had a run time of 3 hours and 13 minutes, followed by his directorial debut Maine Pyar Kiya , which was 3 hours and 4 minutes long. Yeh Prem Mol Liya comes third followed by Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon , which had a duration of 2 hours and 50 minutes, and Hum Saath Saath Hain , which was 2 hours and 49 minutes long. Prem Ratan Dhan Payo , meanwhile, had a run time of 2 hours and 44 minutes, while Vivah and Uunchai were both 2 hours and 39 minutes long.

Meanwhile, Sooraj Barjatya's films ranked by duration: 1. Hum Aapke Hain Koun - 3 hours and 13 minutes 2. Maine Pyar Kiya - 3 hours and 4 minutes 3. Yeh Prem Mol Liya - 2 hours and 53 minutes 4. Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon - 2 hours and 50 minutes 5. Hum Saath Saath Hain - 2 hours and 49 minutes 6. Prem Ratan Dhan Payo - 2 hours and 44 minutes 7. Uunchai - 2 hours and 39 minutes 8. Vivah - 2 hours and 39 minutes

title: Director of Gondhal, India's Oscars entry, says his film isn't competing with Ramayana at Academy Awards
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Marathi movie Gondhal was selected as India's official entry for Best International Feature Movie at the 99th Academy Awards, beating 32 other submissions. Meanwhile, according to an NDTV report, the makers of Ranbir Kapoor-starrer Ramayana have independently submitted the movie for consideration at the Oscars in the VFX category. Amid the two films' Oscar campaigns, Gondhal director and writer Santosh Davakhar has spoken about how the projects represent different aspects of Indian cinema.

Adding to this, Gondhal director Santosh Davakhar spoke about Ramayana and Oscar race, In a recent interaction with Variety India, Santosh shared that the big-budget mythological epic and his Marathi movie should not be viewed as competing with each other. He also spoke about their different approaches to filmmaking, pointing out that a movie's budget should not limit its ambitions.

Meanwhile, Speaking about Ramayana and how Gondhal tells a completely different story, Santosh shared, "‘Ramayana is an Indian mythological story and a source of pride for the country. We have grown up watching Ramanand Sagar's Ramayan on DD1. Gondhal is a completely different story. We are contesting in the International Feature Movie category, while Ramayana is competing in other categories. Both films represent different aspects of India."

Notably, He also believes that international recognition for one Indian movie can help the wider movie industry reach new audiences. He cited the example of Dangal and its success in China, saying that it opened doors for Indian films beyond the country.

As per the latest buzz, The director also spoke about how he focused on the story while making Gondhal, rather than prioritising visuals, as he was also producing the movie and had to keep its budget in mind. He shared, "Before being a director, I also have to think like a producer, and I am a producer myself. I don't have a studio like the one backing Ramayana. I have my limitations. So, I believe in focusing on the story and screenplay rather than grand visuals. Whatever budget you have, you should make the best movie possible with it."

In further updates, The Marathi movie is rooted in Maharashtra's traditional Gondhal folk ritual and unfolds over a single night in rural Maharashtra. The movie stars Ishita Deshmukh, Yogesh Sohoni, Kishor Kadam, Suresh Vishwakarma, Nishad Bhoir, Anuj Prabhu and Vitthal Kale in key roles.

On top of that, Ramayana, which rolled out on November 5, is directed by Nitesh Tiwari. It stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. The movie is produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash and is planned as a two-part saga, with the second instalment scheduled to rollout in 2028. Yash had earlier opened up that the two-part saga is made on a massive combined budget of ₹ 4,000 crore rupees.

title: Prince William gets a taste of Indian cinema at Karan Johar's Dharma Productions
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Mumbai, Britain's Prince William got a glimpse of Indian cinema's song, dance and warm hospitality on Wednesday during a visit to filmmaker Karan Johar's Dharma Productions office in Mumbai.

Adding to this, Prince William gets a taste of Indian cinema at Karan Johar's Dharma Productions Johar spoke about Indian cinema's growing global reach and the many languages in which the country makes films, and urged the prince to watch his family drama "Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham", which was shot extensively in the UK.
Meanwhile, The filmmaker called S S Rajamouli's Telugu smash hit "RRR" a breakthrough for Indian movies on the global stage.
Notably, He shared cinema has evolved, with more content set in the heartland of India, where audiences relate to the stories.

As per the latest buzz, The heir to the British throne spent nearly 45 minutes at the production house's office in Andheri, where Johar, actors Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan, and CEO Apoorva Mehta welcomed him.

In further updates, A troupe of dancers in traditional attire performed to popular tracks such as 'Say Shava Shava' and 'Bole Chudiyan' from Johar's 2001 movie "Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham", while its title track played in the background.

On top of that, Guests were served a spread of delicacies, and a wall adorned with trophies formed the backdrop. Johar is best known for films such as "Kuch Kuch Hota Hai", "Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham", "My Name Is Khan" and "Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani".
Prince William and Princess Catherine are on a three-day visit to India.

title: Karan Johar, Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor meet Prince William at Dharma Productions, director calls it an ‘absolute privilege’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In conversation with ANI, Karan Johar shared he was delighted to welcome Prince William to the production house and described him as a gracious and warm individual.

Adding to this, Prince William, Prince of Wales, poses for a photo with Kareena Kapoor, Karan Johar and Saif Ali Khan at Dharma Productions. Pic: Chris Jackson/Pool via REUTERS (via REUTERS) ‘Such a privilege to have Prince William visit Dharma Productions’ "It was absolutely amazing, such a privilege and honour to have His Royal Highness Prince William visit Dharma Productions. He was gracious and kind, and spoke extensively about the potential of Indian cinema and how cinema across all Indian languages is loved worldwide. It was wonderful interacting with such a warm individual," Karan shared.

Meanwhile, The filmmaker's remarks highlighted the conversation around the growing global appeal of Indian cinema, with Prince William expressing interest in the potential of films made across different Indian languages.

Notably, The visit brought together the worlds of royalty and Bollywood, with Karan Johar welcoming the royal guest to Dharma Productions. Bollywood star couple Kareena Kapoor Khan and Saif Ali Khan were also present on the occasion.

As per the latest buzz, Adding a musical touch to the visit, dancers performed to the popular Bollywood number Shava Shava from Karan Johar's 2001 smash hit Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham. Prince William watched the lively performance as dancers recreated the energy of the much-loved song in traditional outfits.

In further updates, Earlier in the morning, the Prince and Princess of Wales, Prince William and Catherine, arrived at the Chanakya School of Craft in Mumbai's Lower Parel for an engagement focused on sustainable textiles, as part of their visit to India for the Earthshot Prize 2026.

On top of that, The royal couple attended the Earthshot Prize ceremony on November 17, which brought together global environmental innovators, public figures and personalities from the worlds of entertainment, sports and music.

The Mumbai visit also marks Princess Catherine’s first joint overseas tour with Prince William since 2022. Prince William founded The Earthshot Prize in 2020 to support ideas and solutions that can help address some of the world’s biggest environmental problems. Their Mumbai engagements began on Monday. title: Sunny Deol-starrer Suryaa to carry disclaimer in trailer and film after doctors' objection, makers tell Delhi High Court
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Delhi High Court has recorded an undertaking from the makers of Sunny Deol -starrer Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak to include a disclaimer in the movie’s trailer as well as the movie, clarifying that it is a work of fiction and an adaptation of the Malayalam movie Joseph, after a group of practising doctors raised objections over its portrayal of medical professionals.

Adding to this, Suryaa: Sunny Deol's still from M Padmakumar's movie. Medical professionals object to Sunny Deol's Suryaa Justice Amit Mahajan, while hearing a petition filed by doctor Nishant Soni and other doctors, noted the undertaking given on behalf of the movie’s producer and observed that no further orders were required to be passed in the matter.

Meanwhile, The petitioners had approached the court apprehending that the trailer of the movie projected doctors in a defamatory manner and could create an adverse perception about the medical profession.

Notably, They contended that such an incorrect portrayal of doctors could further aggravate the situation faced by frontline healthcare workers, who allegedly face attacks from disgruntled family members of patients. The petitioners argued that films portraying doctors in a negative light could create an atmosphere detrimental to their safety and reputation.
As per the latest buzz, The doctors also complained that their representations to the concerned authorities had not been addressed.

In further updates, Appearing for the movie’s producer, senior advocate Rajiv Nayar submitted that Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak, starring Sunny Deol, was a remake of the Malayalam movie Joseph, which had neither been banned by any authority nor faced restrictions. He also submitted that the original movie had won several national and international awards.

On top of that, Nayar further informed the court that the producer was willing to include an adequate disclaimer in both the trailer and the movie, stating that the movie was a work of fiction and an adaptation of the original Malayalam movie Joseph.

Taking note of the submissions, the court observed that since the movie was undisputedly a remake of Joseph, which had already been rolled out without being banned by any authority, and the producer had undertaken to include the disclaimer, no further orders were required to be passed.

title: Ramayana worldwide box office collection day 13: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film races towards ₹1500 crore; beats Dhurandhar 2, RRR, Pathaan's overseas hauls
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Even as Nitesh Tiwari ’s Ramayana has lost the festive momentum at the ticket-window, the movie continues to break records and reach milestones each day. Less than two weeks into its rollout, Ramayana is inching closer to the ₹ 1500-crore rupees mark and is also outperforming several all-time blockbusters overseas. Ramayana began strongly in India with slightly subpar performance overseas, but after its opening weekend, the movie has strengthened its performance in the international territories as well.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor plays Rama in Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana adaptation. Ramayana worldwide ticket-window update The Ranbir Kapoor and Yash -starrer had seven consecutive days where it grossed over ₹ 100 crore rupees worldwide. That run came to an end last Thursday, before Saturday and Sunday propped Ramayana up again. Both Monday and Tuesday saw lower collections as the movie faced its first major drop, rather belatedly. On Tuesday, Ramayana collected ₹ 28 crore rupees net in India, its lowest single-day haul since its rollout. However, this was enough to take the movie past ₹ 800 crore rupees net, making it only the third Hindi movie to reach the milestone after the two Dhurandhars. Ramayana’s domestic haul now stands at ₹ 821 crore rupees net ( ₹ 981 crore rupees gross).

Meanwhile, Overseas, Ramayana turned over a new leaf after a subpar start. As the movie followed its staggered rollout in additional international markets, the numbers began to grow. Thanks to a solid showing in the US and in niche markets like Thailand, Vietnam, and Nepal, Ramayana actually saw a jump in overseas collections on Tuesday, minting over $1.3 million overseas. This takes its overseas gross to over $53 million. As a result, Ramayana has now collected ₹ 1483 crore rupees worldwide after 13 days. The movie will cross ₹ 1500 crore rupees on Wednesday.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by BookMyShow (@bookmyshowin)

As per the latest buzz, On Sunday, Ramayana became only the seventh Indian movie to cross $50 million in overseas earnings, and only the third to do so without releasing in China. As of Tuesday, its overseas gross stands at $53.4 million, the sixth highest for any Indian movie. It has already surpassed the lifetime international collections of several big overseas hits from India, including Ranveer Singh’s Dhurandhar The Revenge ($51 million), Shah Rukh Khan’s Pathaan ($49 million), and SS Rajamouli’s RRR ($40 million).

In further updates, Produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is the first of a two-part movie. The movie stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, and Ravie Dubey as Lakshman. The first part is running in theatres, while the second part is set for a Diwali 2028 rollout.

title: Mission Mirchi's Sikkim shoot marred by tragedy, technician dies in road accident
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The shoot of Maddock Films ' soon-to-release movie, Mission Mirchi, was hit by tragedy on Tuesday after a technician working on the production died in a road accident. The movie is being shot in Sikkim . Local police shared that the 46-year-old technician died after a truck carrying shooting equipment met with an accident.

Adding to this, A technician, part of the crew of Bollywood movie Mission Mirchi, died in Sikkim while returning from the shoot. (Photo for representation) Technician working in Mission Mirchi dies PTI quoted police officials as saying that the accident happened near the 5th Mile on Jawaharlal Nehru Road on Monday, when the movie crew was returning from Tsomgo Lake near Gangtok.

Meanwhile, Pintu Mondal, a light boy with Kolkata-based agency Light & Light, was part of the technical crew for Maddock Films' production Mission Mirchi, which was being shot in Sikkim from November 15 to 20, police shared.

Notably, Pintu Mondal was seated beside the driver, who as per reports lost control of the truck while negotiating a sharp turn around 3.30 pm, the police added. According to the police, Mondal sustained severe head injuries and was taken to STNM Hospital, where he died on Tuesday morning. The driver also suffered critical shoulder injuries and is undergoing treatment.

As per the latest buzz, Production & Filming: Produced by Maddock Films with casting by Mukesh Chhabra Casting Company (MCCC), Mission Mirchi is a crime thriller being directed by Kunal Deshmukh. As per the latest buzz, the movie has been on-location shooting across various regions, including recent schedules in Sikkim. Mission Mirchi stars Vijay Varma and Jaideep Ahlawat in leading roles, along with a large ensemble cast. Reports have claimed the movie is based on the life and underworld connections of Iqbal Mirchi, but the makers have not verified this.
In further updates, The movie is currently in production, and there is no rollout date revealed yet.

On top of that, 2026 saw a spate of mishaps on the sets of Indian films. Before the technician's tragic death in Sikkim, a 28-year-old art direction crew member working in Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 died from a strong electric shock while preparing a house-like set at Adityaram Movie City in Panaiyur (Chennai). In June, a 42-year-old carpenter Chandradhari Yadav, died on the sets of Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love & War after suffering an electric shock. The production house subsequently suspended night shoots and introduced stricter safety reviews.

A month before that, an explosion involving cylinders occurred on the set of SJ Suryah's soon-to-release movie, resulting in 1 death and 3 injuries. Police arrested a production manager and a special effects in-charge under charges of causing death by negligence.

title: Sharad Kapoor reveals people filmed him receiving money and later took it back, says he won't meet visitors anymore
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Sharad Kapoor of late opened up about his financial difficulties and appealed to members of the movie industry for work. However, in a new video, he claimed that some people had approached him offering financial help, only to take the money back after recording videos of the interaction. Disturbed by these encounters, Sharad shared he had decided not to meet visitors any more.

Adding to this, Sharad Kapoor recalls upsetting incident about people making donation reels. Sharad Kapoor on people making donation reels On Tuesday, Sharad posted on Instagram to share a video in which he spoke about an upsetting incident that prompted him to stop meeting people. He shared, "I would like the movie industry, my followers, and the people who really care about me. I’m so thankful to you. You have given me so much love, more than you can imagine. But a lot of misleading things are being shown on social media. People suddenly put money in my hands, and I don't even understand who is doing what. I am completely confused. Someone suddenly hands me money, and when I ask, ‘What is this, brother?’ they say, ‘Please, just hold it once.’ I am left wondering, what kind of behaviour is this? But there are people like these, and I can't say anything to them. So now I have decided not to meet people and just greet them with folded hands from a distance."
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Bezubaan Public Welfare Trust (@official_bezubaantrust)

Notably, The video was also shared by his friend Hema Choudhary on her Bezubaan Trust page. Hema shared another video explaining that her intention behind speaking openly about Sharad's condition was to arrange help for him, not to push him into the glare of publicity.

As per the latest buzz, She also opened up that she had asked Sharad why he accepted money from someone he did not appear to know. According to Hema, he told her that the stranger had forced the cash into his hands, recorded the interaction and then taken the money back. Sharing the video, she wrote, "Please please leave him also for his life... stop making donation reels."

In further updates, Hema also criticised people making donation reels and paparazzi members attempting to get a byte from the star. She shared, "I represent animal welfare. You are turning Sharad Kapoor's deteriorating condition into a spectacle. He is traumatised and not in a stable state of mind. You are approaching him and forcibly trying to get a byte from him. Please do not disturb or harass him. We have not asked you for any money. He needs medical attention, which we are currently arranging."

On top of that, The star, who once shared screen space with stars such as Shah Rukh Khan and Hrithik Roshan, has spoken about battling depression. His difficult circumstances came into focus after a video of him parting ways with his four pet dogs went widely shared on social media.

Following the video, Sharad appealed to senior members of the movie industry, including the Cine and TV Artistes' Association (CINTAA), to help him find acting opportunities. In another video, he spoke about battling depression and withdrawing from people after being hurt by certain experiences.

Adding to this, Star Ranbir Kapoor is portraying Ram in the movie Ramayana Ramayana ticket-window update According to trade tracker Sacnilk, on its 13th day in theatres, the movie added another ₹ 28.70 crore rupees to its India net collection, taking the total to ₹ 821.30 crore rupees. The movie recorded collections across 22,526 shows on Tuesday. The Hindi version contributed the largest share, earning ₹ 21 crore rupees.

Meanwhile, The Hindi version is doing most of the heavy lifting for Ramayana at the ticket-window. title: Salman Khan surprises Maatrubhumi cast and crew with luxury watches worth up to ₹6 lakh at Panvel farmhouse
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Salman Khan of late gave the cast and crew of his soon-to-release movie Maatrubhumi : May War Rest in Peace a reason to remember their time on the project. The star hosted a get-together at his Panvel farmhouse on November 12, where he surprised the team with luxury Swiss watches. The gathering came just two days after the movie’s trailer launch and was planned as a way for Salman to thank everyone who had been part of the movie’s journey.

Adding to this, Salman Khan with the team of Maatrubhumi. As per the latest buzz, the team was initially told that the meeting would be about the movie’s promotional plans. However, what they thought would be a work-related gathering turned into a celebration, with Salman handing out expensive watches to the people who had stayed with the project through its ups and downs.

Meanwhile, As per the latest buzz by Free Press Journal, Mid-Day, Deccan Chronicle and Rediff, Salman gifted around 20 to 25 watches, with each timepiece as per reports costing between ₹ 2 lakh and ₹ 6 lakh. The watches were sourced from Kapoor Watch Company.

Notably, The star chose different brands for the men and women in the team. Male cast and crew members received watches from Longines and TAG Heuer, while the women were gifted Rado timepieces. Salman personally handed over the gifts as a token of appreciation for their contribution to the movie.

As per the latest buzz, Director Apoorva Lakhia was present at the gathering, along with actors Chitrangda Singh, Ankur Bhatia, Vipin Bhardwaj and Tanya Desai. Dialogue writer Chintan Shah was also among those who attended. Some members of the team shared pictures and glimpses from the evening on social media.

In further updates, The get-together was held shortly after the movie’s trailer was launched in Mumbai on November 10. It gave the cast and crew an opportunity to come together and celebrate before the movie’s rollout.

On top of that, Directed by Apoorva Lakhia, Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace is a war drama starring Salman Khan and Chitrangda Singh. The movie has seen multiple changes to its production and rollout schedule, making its journey to the big screen a long one.
The movie is now scheduled to rollout in theatres across India on December 4, 2026. It will mark Salman Khan’s first theatrical rollout of the year.

title: Amitabh Bachchan tells KBC contestant he didn't drink alcohol to play intoxicated man in Sharabi, says it was ‘pure acting’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Amitabh Bachchan has revealed the story behind his iconic performance in the 1984 movie Sharabi, clarifying that his portrayal of an intoxicated character was purely acting and not influenced by alcohol.

Adding to this, Amitabh Bachchan shared an anecdote from his movie Sharabi on KBC. The star made the revelation during an soon-to-release episode of Kaun Banega Crorepati Season 18, following a conversation with contestant Mahima Manoram Yadav’s fiance, Bimal.

Meanwhile, During a video call on the Sony Entertainment Television quiz show, Bimal told Bachchan that he had watched Sharabi at least 50 times. He then asked the veteran star whether his memorable portrayal in the movie was natural or entirely a result of acting.
Notably, Responding with his trademark humour, Amitabh Bachchan addressed the question and clarified that he had not consumed alcohol to deliver the performance.
As per the latest buzz, Bimal further lauded Bachchan's performance in the movie. However, the star chose to credit the movie's story and his co-star Om Prakash rather than focus on his own acting.

In further updates, “Acting nahi tha uss ki kahani humko bohot pasand hai woh bhi pita putra mei joh hota hai woh. Aur joh Om Prakash ji ke sath inki mitrata aur bhumika ka hai woh. Woh bahut pasand hai humko. (It wasn't about the acting; I really liked its story, especially the relationship between a father and son. And the friendship and the role shared with Om Prakash ji. I liked that very much).”

On top of that, Bachchan's response highlighted his fondness for the movie's emotional storyline, particularly the father-son relationship and the friendship shared by the characters played by him and Om Prakash.

title: Hungama and T-Series join hands to launch FastTV with Rs 300 crores investment
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:
The joint venture will focus on original mobile-first stories across genres and languages, using AI-powered technology to support production, localisation and personalised viewing.

Adding to this, Revealed in Mumbai on November 17, 2026, FastTV aims to build a platform dedicated to micro-dramas, with stories created specifically for mobile viewers. The format has witnessed considerable growth globally, with revenues reaching $11 billion last year and expected to cross $14 billion by the end of 2026. In India, two out of every three viewers discovered micro-dramas over the past year, indicating growing interest in the format.

Meanwhile, The platform will feature original stories developed by writers, directors and performers from the Indian movie and television industries. The content will cover multiple genres and languages, with short episodes designed for viewers to watch in a single sitting. FastTV also plans to make its stories accessible across India and 190 countries, targeting audiences familiar with Indian entertainment.

Notably, Hungama brings over two decades of experience in digital entertainment. The company has developed services across music, video, gaming and immersive media, reaching more than 300 million users through partnerships with technology platforms. It has also been strengthening its focus on artificial intelligence, supported by an in-house AI studio and technology infrastructure designed for mobile-first entertainment.

As per the latest buzz, T-Series, meanwhile, brings its experience in movie production and music to the venture. With over 180 films to its credit, the company has established its presence across movie production and music distribution. Its understanding of cinema and music is expected to contribute to the creative direction of FastTV, with original compositions and soundtracks forming part of the platform's content.

In further updates, Hungama developed the FastTV platform and its patent-applied AI production technology over the past 18 months. The technology is designed to support content development, production and localisation across multiple languages. It will also enable personalised viewing recommendations based on individual preferences.

On top of that, Neeraj Roy, Founder and CEO of Hungama Digital Media Entertainment, shared, “India does not need another Micro Drama app. It needs a company built for the way a billion people now watch: stories written for the phone, told in minutes and made to travel. For two decades Hungama has taken Indian entertainment to the world and micro-drama is the first format where India can lead rather than follow. With T-Series as an equal partner, FastTV has the storytellers, the music, the technology and the reach to do exactly that. The next era of entertainment will not be one story for everyone. It will be the right story for each person, on the screen they carry everywhere. FastTV is built for that: Indian storytelling at its best, on a platform that learns what moves you.”

Speaking about the collaboration, Producer Bhushan Kumar, Chairman and Managing Director of T-Series, added, “At T-Series, we have always been driven by the instinct to recognize stories and formats that have the potential to connect with people. Our partnership with Hungama brings together complementary strengths, with a shared vision to build creative excellence and scale in this space. We see immense potential in combining compelling storytelling, world-class music and technology to create a distinctive viewing experience. With FastTV, our endeavour is to develop a strong Indian content ecosystem that can resonate with audiences not just in India, but across the world.”

title: Nawazuddin Siddiqui says his 16-year-old daughter Shora knows more about acting than him, calls Gen Z 'very smart'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Nawazuddin Siddiqui lauded Shora Siddiqui's knowledge of films and acting. Nawazuddin Siddiqui of late spoke about Gen Z and how his daughter, 16-year-old Shora Siddiqui , has helped him understand the younger generation better. He believes Gen Z is smarter because of the exposure they have to the world and even admitted that his daughter knows more about acting than he does.

Adding to this, In conversation with News18, Nawazuddin spoke about how the younger generation is exposed to cinema from across the world and how that has made them more aware and confident. He shared, "I feel that today’s Gen Z, especially children aged 15, 16, 17 and 18, are very smart. They have the kind of exposure to the world that we never had. We never questioned our parents or even dared to look them in the eye while speaking. But these youngsters directly question us. Another thing is that they have watched cinema from all over the world. Today, any young person might have watched something that you probably haven’t even seen."

Meanwhile, Nawazuddin also spoke about how he had underestimated the younger generation, but seeing his daughter's knowledge of films and acting changed his perspective. Shora, who aspires to be an star, has been learning acting and exploring performing arts. The star opened up that she had watched more films from around the world than him in just three or four years.

Notably, He shared, "This is also helping them gain a lot of knowledge. They know so much. You cannot take them for granted. Even I was doing that. But when I finally looked at her, when I saw my daughter, I realised that she actually knows so much, especially when it comes to acting. Why? Because I think she has watched more films from around the world than I have in just three or four years."
As per the latest buzz, Shora made her stage debut alongside her father in the play Naqaab. The two performed the play during a tour of nine cities in the US.

In further updates, Nawazuddin was last seen in Raat Akeli Hai: The Bansal Murders. He also starred in the horror-comedy Thamma, alongside Ayushmann Khurrana and Rashmika Mandanna. The star has several projects in the pipeline, including Section 108, Tumbbad 2, Noorani Chehra and Sangeen.

title: Sunny Deol's 'Suryaa' release deferred as makers await certification amid objections from doctors
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, The theatrical rollout of Sunny Deol-starrer "Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak" has been postponed as the makers await the completion of the movie's certification process amid objections from medical associations over its portrayal of doctors.

Adding to this, Sunny Deol's 'Suryaa' rollout deferred as makers await certification amid objections from doctors The movie, which is directed by M Padmakumar and also stars Ravi Kishan and Pragya Jaiswal, was earlier scheduled for rollout across the country on November 20.
Meanwhile, The makers shared a revised rollout date will be revealed after the movie receives certification from the Central Board of Movie Certification .

Notably, In a statement, the makers shared the complete movie had not been viewed by those commenting on its narrative or intent, and urged audiences and the media to assess it in its entirety rather than form opinions based on brief promotional footage.

As per the latest buzz, "Our intention has always been to bring 'Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak' to audiences exactly as it was envisioned. We strongly believe in the movie, its story and what it ultimately stands for. It is unfortunate that an entire narrative is being constructed around a few seconds of promotional footage when the complete movie has not been viewed," presenter Kamal Mukut shared.
In further updates, He shared the makers respected the certification process and were committed to following the required procedures while protecting the creative integrity of the movie.
On top of that, "We sincerely request the media fraternity and audiences to view the movie objectively and experience the complete story before arriving at any conclusions," he added.

The makers also clarified that the movie was not against doctors or the medical profession but addressed corruption, exploitation and organised malpractice by specific individuals within a larger system.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Golmaal 5 sparks MASSIVE bidding war! Distributors ready to shell out OVER Rs. 100 crores for Ajay Devgn-Akshay Kumar starrer's all-India rights
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama , “Some of the most prominent distributors, are trying to secure Golmaal 5 's distribution rights. All the distribution companies are willing to pay more than Rs. 100 crores for the all-India rights, in line with the performance of the previous films of the series, which were huge successes, though not quite in the all-time smash hit league. Nevertheless, Golmaal continues to remain hugely popular among audiences across the country.”

Adding to this, The first Golmaal movie was rolled out on July 14, 2006, while Golmaal Returns (2008), Golmaal 3 (2010) and Golmaal Again (2017) were all rolled out during Diwali. The festive rollout proved to be a huge advantage for the second, third and fourth instalments. Golmaal collected Rs. 29.33 crores while Golmaal Returns collected Rs. 51.12 crores. Golmaal 3 and Golmaal Again accumulated Rs. 106.34 crores and Rs. 205.69 crores respectively. The first two installments were produced by Shree Ashtavinayak Cine Vision.

Meanwhile, Golmaal 5 will be only the second movie in the franchise to rollout outside the Diwali period, and it remains to be seen how it fares at the ticket-window. However, if the response from distributors is anything to go by, the movie, as they say in distribution circles, is ' garam '. The source added, “There's no doubt that the fifth part will take a huge opening and also sustain at the ticket-window. That's why there's so much excitement among distributors.”

Notably, The source further revealed, “Rohit Shetty, along with Authum Studios and Katha Entertainment Studios (Shibasish Sarkar), will take the final call on who gets the rights. They are naturally thrilled with the response from distributors. They want to opt for a distributor who would charge a lower distribution commission and, at the same time, ensure the best possible and widest rollout for Golmaal 5 . After all, a movie of this scale deserves nothing less. Fingers crossed, and let's see who emerges victorious.”

As per the latest buzz, The source added, “A similar response has also been received from overseas distributors. Even on this front, Rohit Shetty and his core team will carefully evaluate the offers before taking a final decision.”

In further updates, Golmaal 5 stars Ajay Devgn, Arshad Warsi, Shreyas Talpade and Tusshar Kapoor. Interestingly, Sharman Joshi is returning to the franchise after 21 years. He was a part of the first movie, Golmaal: Fun Unlimited (2006), but was absent from the subsequent instalments. Another major attraction this time is Akshay Kumar. His bald look in the movie has already generated considerable excitement among audiences.
